title: PhysCodeGym: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Physically Verifiable 4D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.17288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Building physical simulations from video requires coding agents to translate observations into executable models and refine them through tool use. We introduce PhysCodeGym, a benchmark for physically verifiable 4D reconstruction with $156$ tasks covering rigid-body, liquid, deformable, and wind-driven motion. Agents autonomously inspect videos, write and run Blender programs, and revise their scenes using simulation feedback. Six metrics combine rule-based measurements with rubric-based judgments to assess visual and physical reconstruction quality. Program inspection, scene measurements, and counterfactual interventions test physical consistency under original and modified conditions. Experiments with frontier coding agents reveal a tradeoff between artifact quality and completion across reasoning-effort settings, while harness comparisons and agent traces link verification behavior with reconstruction performance. translated_title: PhysCodeGym：面向物理可验证4D重建的编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 从视频构建物理仿真要求编码智能体将观察结果转化为可执行模型，并通过工具使用对其不断改进。我们提出PhysCodeGym，一个用于物理可验证4D重建的基准测试，包含156个任务，涵盖刚体、液体、可变形物体和风驱动运动。智能体自主检查视频、编写并运行Blender程序，并利用仿真反馈修改其场景。六项指标将基于规则的测量与基于量规的评判相结合，以评估视觉和物理重建质量。通过程序检查、场景测量和反事实干预，测试在原始条件和修改条件下场景的物理一致性。对前沿编码智能体的实验揭示了在不同推理努力设置下生成结果质量与任务完成度之间的权衡，同时框架对比和智能体轨迹分析将验证行为与重建性能关联起来。案例研究表明
tldr: PhysCodeGym是一个包含156个任务的物理可验证4D重建基准，要求编码智能体自主编写并通过仿真反馈迭代修正Blender程序以从视频重建可执行物理模型，并以规则测量与量规评判相结合的六项指标评估其视觉与物理重建质量。
en_tdlr: PhysCodeGym is a benchmark of 156 physically verifiable 4D reconstruction tasks where coding agents autonomously write and iteratively refine Blender simulation programs from videos, evaluated by six metrics combining rule-based measurements and rubric-based judgments of visual and physical reconstruction quality.
